title: A Garden for the Veil
author: E. M. Thackeray
blurb: Elodie Whitlock, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
